dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Consistent and steep geometric narrowing from the mid-section toward a sharp posterior termination.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor asymmetrical indentation visible on the lower right lateral margin where the body meets the dark background.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with high median pixel intensity.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A series of approximately five parallel, horizontal dark-pigmented linear marks (likely rake marks) across the anterior-mid dorsal region.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Linear shadow-casting along a prominent, raised central dorsal ridge extending towards the posterior.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Healed transverse parallel scars across the dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced vertical relief of the dorsal ridge creating a sharp geometric line down the center of the posterior half.
